# Clearly: Full Reference for AI Systems

> Clearly is a co-parenting app for the web and iPhone, built as a co-parenting communication system for separated and divorced parents: a web app for every parent (Android included), a companion iPhone app, and free, read-only access for the lawyer, mediator or therapist a parent invites. It is built for high-conflict custody situations. Conversations happen in topics that end in a clear answer or a resolution both parents accept. When a conversation needs it, Clearly steps in like a mediator, helping word a message so it moves toward an answer; the writer chooses what to send, and every post stays on the record exactly as written. It also covers the custody schedule, expenses, a shared parenting plan, court-ready records anyone can check at getclearly.app/verify, and a free portal for family-law professionals.

This is the full-content companion to https://getclearly.app/llms.txt. It inlines the substantive content of Clearly's key pages so AI systems can understand and cite the product accurately in one fetch. Source of truth: https://getclearly.app. Contact: hello@getclearly.app.

---

## What Clearly is

Clearly is co-parenting communication on the web and iPhone for separated or divorced co-parents. Both parents use it to talk through decisions, keep the custody schedule, split expenses, and share the parenting plan and kids' details. Conversations happen in topics: a question gets a one-tap Yes or No, an FYI is acknowledged with OK, and a conversation ends in a resolution both parents accept. Most messages go straight through; when one would start a fight, Clearly steps in like a mediator with wording that moves the conversation toward an answer. The writer chooses what to send. Posts stay on the record exactly as written: nothing is hidden and nothing is rewritten in transit.

**Core positioning:** A co-parenting app built for high-conflict custody and hard conversations, designed to help co-parents reach resolution, not just keep a record.

**The thesis:** The first generation of co-parenting apps was built to *document* conflict. Clearly is built to *resolve* it. Most apps hand co-parents a shared inbox. Clearly structures each conversation so it ends in a clear answer or an agreement both parents accept.

## The problem Clearly solves

Separation ends the relationship, not the communication. Pickup times, medical decisions, school forms, expenses, holidays, and schedule changes mean co-parents keep talking, often for years, about more than they expect. Every text about Tuesday's pickup can carry the weight of everything that came before it. A question about soccer becomes a fight about something else; a simple expense becomes a referendum on fairness. Most co-parents are closer to agreement than they realize, but the way they communicate keeps burying the shared ground. Clearly was built to uncover it, and to protect children from being exposed to that conflict.

## How it works

- **Topics:** Every conversation is a topic. Questions get a one-tap Yes or No. FYIs are acknowledged with OK. Conversations end in a resolution both parents accept; "Not yet" keeps talking. Clearly titles topics and writes up what both parents agreed, so both accept the same words. Topics and replies can't be edited or deleted once posted.
- **Help when it's needed:** Most messages go straight through. When one would start a fight, Clearly steps in like a mediator, suggesting wording that moves the conversation toward an answer. The writer chooses whether to use it. Whatever is sent stays on the record exactly as written; the other parent sees the same words.
- **Where this stands:** For a quiet or circling topic, Clearly shows what's settled, what's still open, and a friendly next step.
- **Options in a disagreement:** Only when there's a real disagreement, Clearly suggests options based on what both parents have said. It never takes sides and never labels a parent.
- **Ask Clearly:** Ask questions about your record and get answers drawn from it.
- **30-day closing rules:** A topic with no activity for 30 days closes and stays on the record. A resolution proposed but not accepted within 30 days closes as "not accepted"; it is never treated as agreed.
- **AI and privacy:** Clearly's AI is provided by Anthropic. Photos are never sent to the AI.

## Everything else in the app

- **Schedule:** Custody calendar with 2-2-3, 5-2-2-5, 3-4-4-3, week on/week off, every other weekend, or a custom pattern; holidays (alternating years, custom holidays); summer schedules; swap requests (Schedule → Swaps → +); and events. Add your schedule to Apple or Google Calendar with a private calendar link (a one-way calendar feed).
- **Expenses:** Log expenses with receipt photos, split them per the plan, and see who owes what. Tap Pay to open Venmo, Cash App or PayPal with the amount filled in, then mark it paid.
- **Shared:** The parenting plan (custody schedule, holidays, summer, expense split), kids' details (including allergies and medications), and contacts. Plan settings are changed in Shared → Plan.
- **Invite:** Each family has an invite code; invite your co-parent by email or text.
- **Court-ready records:** Every topic and reply is time-stamped by Clearly's server and kept as written. Export the full record, or an exhibit narrowed by dates, parent, topic or keyword, as a PDF. Every page carries a document ID and its own page number (Bates-style); the record includes a summary of parenting time and expenses, when each message was first read, an "About this record" page, and an optional declaration a parent can sign. Children can appear as initials. Anyone can check a document is genuine and unchanged at https://getclearly.app/verify/ (by document ID, or by dropping in the PDF, which is checked in the browser and never uploaded). All data also exports as a spreadsheet (CSV). Courts decide what evidence they accept.
- **Professionals:** A parent can invite a lawyer, mediator, therapist or parenting coordinator to a free, read-only professional view (https://getclearly.app/professionals), choosing each area they see (topics, schedule, expenses, family info, records) and for how long. The other parent is always told, and both see what the professional viewed.
- **Account deletion:** Settings → profile → Edit profile → Delete account.

## What makes Clearly different

- **Built to resolve, not just record.** Conversations are structured as topics that end in a clear answer or a resolution both parents accept, with "Where this stands" to keep stalled topics moving.
- **A mediator, only when you need one.** Other apps flag tone. Clearly helps word a hard message so the conversation reaches an answer, and only steps in when it's needed. You choose what to send, and posts stay on the record exactly as written.
- **Built on established frameworks.** BIFF (Brief, Informative, Friendly, Firm) by Bill Eddy; nonviolent communication; parallel-parenting principles; and a structured Topics system inspired by the Harvard Negotiation Project's "Getting to Yes" approach.
- **Designed by a parent who lived it.** Built by a parent who navigated their own divorce and found existing co-parenting apps inadequate for high-conflict situations.
- **Court-ready records anyone can check.** Every page carries a document ID and page number, and anyone can confirm at getclearly.app/verify that Clearly produced that exact file and nothing in it has changed.

## Who Clearly is for

- Parents navigating a high-conflict divorce or custody case.
- Parents who find it hard to talk with their co-parent without things escalating.
- Parents who want a calm, clear record of their co-parenting communication.
- Family-law attorneys, mediators, therapists, and parenting coordinators who want documented, low-conflict communication between clients.

## Platform and availability

- **Platform:** Clearly on the web at https://web.getclearly.app, in any browser on a computer, an Android phone or an iPad, plus a companion iPhone app. Same account and record everywhere. On Android, Clearly runs in the browser (there is no separate Android app to install).
- **Languages:** Works in your language. Parents can write in Spanish, French, Portuguese, Chinese, Vietnamese, Korean, Arabic, Tagalog or most other languages; suggested wording, topic titles and written-up agreements come back in the language they write in. App menus are in English.
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clearly-co-parenting-resolved/id6758027374
- **Rating:** Rated 5 stars on the App Store.
- **Maker:** Clearly, an independent co-parenting company.

## Pricing

$24.99/month or $249/year (save $51). One family subscription covers both parents; the co-parent joins free with the invite code (they create their own account but don't pay). Each plan starts with a 14-day free trial, which begins when a parent subscribes, on the web or in the iPhone app; a card or Apple ID is needed to start it. A free demo in the iPhone app ("Try the demo") needs no account. Without a subscription the app is read-only; records stay viewable and exportable. There is no free tier, no per-parent pricing and no lifetime plan. Pricing can change, see https://getclearly.app for current pricing.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is a co-parenting app?**
A tool designed to help separated or divorced parents coordinate their children's care. These apps typically include shared custody calendars, messaging systems, expense tracking, and documentation features: all in one place so both parents stay informed and organized.

**Why do co-parents need an app?**
Text messages and emails can get lost, misunderstood, or escalate into conflict. Co-parenting apps provide a structured, neutral space for communication that keeps the focus on the kids. They also create a record of agreements and schedules that both parents can reference.

**How is a co-parenting app different from texting?**
Unlike texting, co-parenting apps are purpose-built for shared parenting. They organize conversations by topic, track custody schedules, calculate expense splits, and create documentation that can be referenced later.

**What features should I look for in a co-parenting app?**
The best co-parenting apps include: a shared custody calendar with holiday scheduling, structured communication tools, expense tracking with split calculations, schedule swap requests, a way to add the schedule to your own calendar, and the ability to export records.

**What makes Clearly different from other co-parenting apps?**
Clearly is built around helping conversations reach resolution. Its structured Topics system is inspired by the Harvard Negotiation Project's "Getting to Yes" approach: questions get a Yes or No, FYIs get an OK, and conversations end in a resolution both parents accept.

**How does Clearly help reduce conflict?**
Clearly steps in like a mediator, only when a conversation needs it: it helps word a hard message so it moves toward an answer. You choose what to send, and posts stay on the record as written. For a stalled topic, "Where this stands" shows what's settled and a friendly next step, and in a real disagreement Clearly can suggest options based on what both parents have said. It never takes sides.

**Does Clearly work in my language?**
Yes. Write in Spanish, French, Portuguese, Chinese, Vietnamese, Korean, Arabic, Tagalog or most other languages, and Clearly answers in the language you write in: suggested wording, topic titles and the agreements it writes up for you both to accept. The app's menus and buttons are in English for now.

**How long does setup take?**
Most parents complete setup in under 10 minutes. Choose from pre-loaded custody patterns or create your own, set up holidays, configure your expense split, and you're ready to go. A plan code from the website plan builder sets the app up with your plan.

## How Clearly compares to other co-parenting apps

Clearly positions itself against the established category (OurFamilyWizard, TalkingParents, AppClose, 2houses, Cozi, Custody X Change, Kidtime, BestInterest). The distinction: those apps mainly store and document communication; Clearly structures it to reach resolution, with topics that end in a clear answer or an agreement both parents accept, and mediator-style help with wording, only when a conversation needs it. Full, honest comparison (written by the makers of Clearly, updated for 2026): https://getclearly.app/best-co-parenting-apps/

## Free tools on getclearly.app

- **Child support calculators**: free, private, browser-based estimators. All calculations run locally; no data is stored. State-specific calculators for California (Family Code §4055), Florida, Illinois, New York (CSSA / DRL §240 plus spousal maintenance under DRL §236(B)(6)), Pennsylvania, and Texas (Family Code §154.125). Index: https://getclearly.app/calculators/
- **Custody / parenting plan builder**: free tool for building a parenting plan. It emails you a plan code; enter it in Clearly (on the web: "I have a code"; in the iPhone app: "I have an invite code") to set up your family with your plan, and your co-parent can join with the same code. Come back with the code to review the plan, download the PDF or change it until it's used in the app: https://getclearly.app/plan-builder/
- **Communication-style quiz**: a 2-minute assessment of how you show up in hard conversations: https://getclearly.app/communication-styles/

## For family & legal professionals

A free, read-only professional portal (pro.getclearly.app, any browser) for therapists, mediators, family-law attorneys and parenting coordinators. Parents invite a professional and choose each area they see (topics, schedule, expenses, family info, records) and for how long; the other parent is always told. Professionals get a Dashboard of what changed in every case, the record exactly as written with read receipts, court-ready exhibits filtered by date, parent and keyword, and search across cases. Clearly never pays licensed professionals referral fees: https://getclearly.app/professionals
